layers.text:
Ministry of Environment approves
euthanasia of more than 80 hippos

An Indian billionaire, Anant Ambani,
offers transport and shelter in India

Hacienda Nápoles, where the hippos were
first kept

captions.text: Pablo Escobar's hippos are still alive, and Colombia has approved killing them.
In 1981, he imported four of them for his private zoo.
His estate lay between Medellín and Bogotá.
After he died in 1993, they escaped and spread.
By 2007 there were sixteen, by 2014 about forty, and now around two hundred.
In April 2026, Colombia approved killing over eighty.
An Indian billionaire offered them a home.
Conservationists call them invasive; some ecologists disagree.
